query:
SELECT s.id AS "id!",
                      COALESCE(m.last_at, s.started_at) AS "last_activity!"
                 FROM sessions s
                 LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT session_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_at
                    FROM session_messages
                    GROUP BY session_id
                 ) m ON m.session_id = s.id
                WHERE s.agent_type = 'chat' AND s.status = 'running'
